# fix-error Skill

This skill is designed to help diagnose and resolve runtime, build, or syntax errors in the MABOTE GROUP Stockvel app repository.

## What it does

- Guides the agent through reproducing the failure
- Inspects relevant files and config
- Identifies the root cause
- Applies a minimal fix
- Verifies the solution

## Example prompts

- "Fix the build error in this repo"
- "Debug the runtime error when opening the app"
- "There is a React syntax error in `src/main.jsx`; help me resolve it"

## Location

- `.github/skills/fix-error/SKILL.md`
- Registered in `AGENTS.md`
